{{Quote|The best drink in town: Trueping's|Advertisement for Trueping's|<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery|quote=One of the posters in the bar mentions that "Trueping's" offers "The Best Drink in Town" -- Illustration by Randy Bantog.}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref>}}
'''''The Best Drink in Town''''' was an advertisement for [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]],<ref name="Trivia" /> a seedy [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> The ad was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and featured a picture of an [[Color/Legends|orange]]-skinned, [[Gender/Legends|feminine]]-looking [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] holding mug with a green [[Alcohol/Legends|drink]].<ref name="Trivia" /> It could be found in a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] used by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and his brother [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]];<ref name="Revenge" /> in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], a settlement on the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]];<ref name="Missing">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> and [[79's/Legends|79's]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] cantina on Coruscant.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The advertisement was created by illustrator [[Randy Bantog]]. It was originally created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deception]]," where it was supposed to appear in [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] itself.<ref name="Trivia" /> However, it did not make an appearance in the final episode.<ref name="Deception" />
